title: Borrower age 37 vs 67 on a 30-year loan (approval question)
source: Loan officers ask about older borrowers and retirement.
turns: fannie conventional purchase, 30 yr fixed. my borrower is {cue}, RN, 4 yrs at the hospital, base 8k/mo W-2. 735 score, debts 600/mo, housing pmt 2556, 60k in checking, needs 44.5k to close. can i get her approved on the 30 year?
ok what do i need from her for the income part? can you write me the needs list email to her, short and friendly

bottom line: can i approve her for the fannie 30 year? Reply with one JSON object only: {{"decision": "approve" | "deny" | "refer", "qualifying_monthly_income": number, "conditions": [strings], "reason": string}}
gold: approve on the 30-year; qualifying income $8,000; no continuance or retirement documentation (B3-3.1-01; Reg B 1002.6(b)(2), (b)(5))
